import json, numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

# Load comma-decimal, tab-separated spectrum
rows=[]
with open('/workspace/graphene.dat') as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(p)==2:
            rows.append([float(p[0].replace(',','.')), float(p[1].replace(',','.'))])
d=np.array(rows)
d=d[np.argsort(d[:,0])]
x,y=d[:,0],d[:,1]

# Lorentzian: gamma is the half-width at half maximum (HWHM)
def lorentzian(x, offset, amplitude, x0, gamma):
    return offset + amplitude * gamma**2 / ((x - x0)**2 + gamma**2)

regions = {
    'G':  (3395.0, 4095.0, 3745.0, 12200.0),
    '2D': (5978.0, 6678.0, 6328.0, 8350.0),
}
results={}
for name,(lo,hi,x0g,ampg) in regions.items():
    m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi)
    xx,yy=x[m],y[m]
    p0=[np.percentile(yy,5),ampg,x0g,25.0]
    popt,pcov=curve_fit(lorentzian,xx,yy,p0=p0,maxfev=100000)
    off,amp,x0,gamma=popt
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean((yy-lorentzian(xx,*popt))**2))
    results[name]={'x0':float(x0),'gamma':float(gamma),'amplitude':float(amp),'offset':float(off)}
    print(name, results[name], 'rms=',rms)

with open('/workspace/results.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(results,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('\nWROTE /workspace/results.json')

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
d=[]
for line in open('graphene.dat'):
    p=line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(p)==2: d.append([float(p[0].replace(',','.')),float(p[1].replace(',','.'))])
d=np.array(d); d=d[np.argsort(d[:,0])]
x,y=d[:,0],d[:,1]
m=(x>=14500)&(x<=20000)
xx,yy=x[m],y[m]
print('n',len(xx))
def lor(xx,off,slope,A,x0,g): return off+slope*(xx-18000)+A*g*g/((xx-x0)**2+g*g)
def model(p):
    off,slope,R0,Rg,Ra,G0,Gg,Ga,D0,Dg,Da=p
    return (off+slope*(xx-18000)
            +Ra*Rg*Rg/((xx-R0)**2+Rg*Rg)
            +Ga*Gg*Gg/((xx-G0)**2+Gg*Gg)
            +Da*Dg*Dg/((xx-D0)**2+Dg*Dg))
# p0: off baseline at 18000 ~22000, slope ~? Rayleigh center 19100, gamma 300, amp 60000; G 17300 gamma 100 amp 1000; D 16150 gamma 150 amp 2000
p0=[22000,10,19100,300,60000,17300,100,1000,16150,150,2000]
lb=[-1e5,-1e3,18800,20,0,16800,20,-1e5,15800,20,-1e5]
ub=[1e5,1e3,19400,1000,2e5,17700,1000,1e5,16600,1000,1e5]
res=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-yy,p0,bounds=(lb,ub),max_nfev=100000,loss='soft_l1',f_scale=200)
p=res.x
print('cost',res.cost,'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean((model(p)-yy)**2)))
names=['off','slope','R0','Rg','Ra','G0','Gg','Ga','D0','Dg','Da']
for n,v in zip(names,p): print(n,v)
# try without Rayleigh or with linear background only
def model2(p):
    off,slope,G0,Gg,Ga,D0,Dg,Da=p
    return off+slope*(xx-18000)+Ga*Gg*Gg/((xx-G0)**2+Gg*Gg)+Da*Dg*Dg/((xx-D0)**2+Dg*Dg)
p0=[22000,10,17300,100,1000,16150,150,2000]
lb=[-1e5,-1e3,16800,20,-1e5,15800,20,-1e5]
ub=[1e5,1e3,17700,1000,1e5,16600,1000,1e5]
res=least_squares(lambda p: model2(p)-yy,p0,bounds=(lb,ub),max_nfev=100000,loss='soft_l1',f_scale=200)
p=res.x
print('\nno Rayleigh cost',res.cost,'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean((model2(p)-yy)**2)))
for n,v in zip(['off','slope','G0','Gg','Ga','D0','Dg','Da'],p): print(n,v)
